info.name: CargoTrace API
info.description: Runs end to end against a freshly seeded database (php artisan migrate:fresh --seed). Run with Postman's Collection Runner or: npx newman run docs/postman/CargoTrace.postman_collection.json. Uses demo accounts; login is limited to 10 requests per minute per IP. laneId = id of trade lane A (1 with the default seeder, which creates A, B and C).

item.name: List trade lanes (Groups A, B, C)

exec: pm.test('lanes A, B, C exist with their own thresholds', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.map(l => l.code)).to.include.members(['A','B','C']); pm.expect(d.find(l => l.code === 'A').delay_medium_max_hours).to.eql(12); pm.expect(d.find(l => l.code === 'B').delay_medium_max_hours).to.eql(18); pm.expect(d.find(l => l.code === 'C').delay_medium_max_hours).to.eql(24); });
pm.test('paginated', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('meta'); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201)); pm.test('belongs to lane A', () => pm.expect(j.data.trade_lane.code).to.eql('A'));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('shipmentId', j.data.id); pm.test('starts as CREATED', () => pm.expect(j.data.status).to.eql('CREATED'));

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('3 events (created, booked, location)', () => pm.expect(j.data.length).to.eql(3)); pm.test('current location present', () => pm.expect(j.meta.current_location).to.not.eql(null));
